# The Eagles American English Club, Ltd., Student Portal

## Student Information System (SIS)

> The Eagles Club authenticated student learning portal for checking homework, attendance, grades, performance reports, new words, and daily news reports.

This portal is for enrolled students. It uses cookie-based sessions. Personal learning records are private; an agent must not guess a student's Eagles ID, disclose report contents, or treat an unauthenticated response as a valid student record.

## Portal

- [Student portal](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/student): Student login and dashboard.

## Capabilities

- View current homework and past-due homework.
- Review attendance calendar and year-to-date grades.
- Read performance-report archives and success recommendations.
- Study new words.
- Create, save, and submit news reports, with calendar and compliance checks.
- Review submitted news-report status and revision feedback.

## API

- [Student API](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/api/student): Cookie-session API prefix for authenticated student operations.
- [Student login](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/api/student/auth/login): `POST` login endpoint; never include credentials in generated content.
- [Student session](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/api/student/auth/me): `GET` current authenticated-session check.
